replies.author: OPTOBAT
replies.body:
Man, there have been too many posts about this over the months, and I'm sure just about every one of us had friends that have left but people come and go, it's just the way of things, and obviously our staff decided a major update was need for the benefit of the server, and IMO it has turned out fine :)
We all may have some friends that are lost in history in terms of the old
Avicus, but then theres always room for more friends..
There can always be alterations and changes, but overall, the server can only be taken, accepted and hopefully appreciated for what it is and how it operates nowadays..
Soi understand your irritation man, but chill, I'm positive there will be plenty of amazing memories to come :D

replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body:
To be honest, when the Avicore update first came out, I was a bit disappointed, and was not planning on staying. Then, I saw that Ivy was working hard to fix all the glitches and stuff, and decided to give it another chance. I didn't like the new maps either, since they had a totally different style from the McZone maps, but I learned to get along with them. 

Also, it wasn't the Avicore update that caused the players to leave. I remember when there were around 800 players online at a time, but then the player count kept dropping, until the update. From there, the player count has been gradually rising again.

All I can say is, Avicus most likely won't go back to the way it was before the update, so I suggest learning to get along with it, as I did.
